text_block_list.text:
The first three years with Super Creek
were nothing short of legendary success.
And with such overwhelming strength, that rumor—which had once died down—came back to life.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Super Creek takes yet another overwhelming victory!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Truly a formidable wall standing before all horse girls!
No one can win, no one...!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, um, I was just running normally.
I just got lucky.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "I'll just run normally next time too. I won't do anything mean, after all♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: B-B-Brrrr!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer-san. Where shall we go
next? Anywhere you'd like~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: B-B-Brrrr!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, that's downright terrifying.
She's got the full-on aura of a Demon Lord.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she's always smiling, which makes it all the more terrifying...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And no one knows.
The other face of those two...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I never expected it'd go that far, though...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~, today I'd like to
try playing the baby talk game~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Somehow, pulling off a cool win in the race left me feeling uneasy. That's why...
choice_data_list: Oh, what am I going to do with you...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Waaah, really? Well then...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there, Trainer♪
Who's a good boy? Yes you are~♪

As her power grows, Super Creek's urge
to pamper others occasionally bursts forth...

If anyone saw me like this, they'd be totally repulsed.
I have to let off steam without anyone finding out.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek dominates once again!
Can nobody bring her down to earth?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'd love to buy you
some clothes that look good on you today~♪

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek takes a thrilling victory!!
Untouchable from start to finish!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I want to give you a lift way up high at the amusement park, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek wins by a landslide!
Just where does this incredible consistency come from?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's take a ba...
Resolving the situation without getting caught proved to be quite an ordeal.

Even so, the everyday Super Creek
remained as calm and gentle as ever.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we've come so far,
haven't we? So far from the day we first met...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Lately, I just haven't been sure about anything.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even though I only pamper him once in a while,
I feel like I'm the one being pampered.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It feels like you skillfully let me do as I please, Trainer.
You're right. I can't even tell where that line is drawn anymore.

Their bond deepened to that extent, and with every
bit it grew, Super Creek became that much stronger.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps the reason I was so drawn to you the day we met...
wasn't merely a desire to spoil you, after all."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You've already become that inseparable from my everyday life, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: To think such an encounter was possible.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: How many times in a lifetime does this even happen...?
"There was likely no need to ask. And this 'just once' would never truly end."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please keep telling me what you want from now on, too.
I'll bring back whatever prize you desire.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Though, maybe winning awards
isn't the point anymore.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, with the trophies we won together...
I want to decorate with them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: From a once-in-a-lifetime encounter, it will continue forever—our path.
